title: Verify Parts and Customers sections are hidden from Sales Representative
preconds: Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Sales Representative role. (this role has Customers = Off and Part Sales = Off).
steps:
1. Look at the main navigation for Customers.
2. Look at the main navigation for Parts / Part Sales.
expected: Customers and Parts/Part Sales do NOT appear in the navigation (or are not editable if reachable) - the role's scope is limited to reports.
